# Browser asset versions

- Bootstrap Icons 1.13.2 (`bootstrap-icons.min.css` and matching fonts in `bootstrap/fonts/`)
- Bootstrap 5.3.8 (`bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`)
- HTMX 2.0.11 (`htmx.min.js`)
- PDF.js 6.3.289 (`pdf.min.mjs`, `pdf.worker.min.mjs`, and matching image decoder assets in `pdfjs/wasm/`)

The PDF.js license is in `pdfjs/LICENSE`. The minified Bootstrap and HTMX files
contain their upstream license notices.

The PDF.js image decoders and color conversion assets come from the same
`pdfjs-dist` release. Their upstream license files are in `pdfjs/wasm/`.

The Bootstrap Icons license is in `bootstrap/bootstrap-icons.LICENSE`.
